title: The Global Economic Impact of Branded Merchandise
gist: A PPAI-commissioned Oxford Economics study finds the global branded merchandise industry generated $472 billion in global GDP, 11.9 million jobs, and $141 billion in tax revenue in 2025, though the detailed white paper and country-level data are gated behind PPAI membership.

insights.claim: The branded merchandise industry contributed $472 billion to global GDP in 2025, according to a study commissioned by PPAI.
insights.speaker: Suki Masana
insights.so_what: Establishes branded merchandise as a large, likely underappreciated global sector comparable in scale to mid-sized national economies, worth tracking as a distinct promotional/marketing-adjacent vertical.
insights.quote: In 2025, the branded merchandise industry supported a $472 billion contribution to global GDP, supporting economic activity across the globe.

insights.claim: The branded merchandise industry supported the employment of 11.9 million jobs globally in 2025.
insights.speaker: Suki Masana
insights.so_what: Signals meaningful global labor exposure to the promotional products supply chain (manufacturing, decoration, distribution), relevant for assessing employment sensitivity to corporate marketing budget cycles.
insights.quote: This economic activity supported the employment of 11.9 million jobs and supported a $141 billion contribution to global tax revenues.

insights.speaker: Suki Masana
insights.so_what: Gives policymakers and industry advocates a quantified fiscal-contribution figure to use in lobbying or tax-policy discussions around the sector.

insights.claim: The branded merchandise industry is framed as a globally integrated value chain linking manufacturers, suppliers, decorators, distributors, retailers, e-commerce platforms, agencies, and activation partners.
insights.speaker: Suki Masana
insights.so_what: Useful map of the sector's structure for identifying which sub-segments (e.g., decorators vs. e-commerce platforms) capture the most value or are most exposed to margin compression.
insights.quote: The branded merchandise industry operates on a truly global scale, connecting manufacturers, suppliers, decorators, distributors, retailers, e-commerce platforms, agencies, and activation partners to enable the production, decoration, and delivery of branded merchandise products to businesses and consumers worldwide.
insights.locator: The branded merchandise industry operates on a truly global scale

insights.claim: The full white paper and detailed country-level results from this economic impact study are only available to PPAI members, limiting independent verification of the methodology behind the headline figures.
insights.speaker: Suki Masana
insights.so_what: Investors or analysts citing these figures should note the underlying data and methodology are gated, warranting caution before treating the $472B/11.9M/$141B numbers as fully auditable.
